summary: Assess REIT structures, property valuations, distributions and portfolio risks through applied analysis. Explore the five-day course.
lede: REIT valuation and portfolio management examines how property cash flows, valuation assumptions and portfolio choices shape investment decisions. It is for REIT analysts, asset managers and investment professionals who need to assess trust design and explain how value, income and funding risks affect decisions. Participants practise testing discounted cash-flow assumptions, reviewing valuation evidence, assessing distribution coverage and debt exposure, comparing portfolio concentration, and preparing investment recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review REIT structures, property cash flows, valuation assumptions or portfolio decisions as part of their regular work.
modules: REIT Cash Flows and Income Quality
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate investment, financial statements and basic valuation concepts is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises use property cash-flow analysis and Excel.
